originality.rationale: Direct comparison with the motivating full preprint distinguishes an unrestricted complete-list linear lower bound from its Theorem 3.5 logarithmic lower bound and its Theorem 3.7 linear bound only for maximum-cardinality matching. Multiple actual record and literature searches found no equivalent result, with residual priority risk explicitly recorded.

value.rationale: The fairness target is the maximum number of individually feasible deviations experienced by one participant. A linear worst-case lower bound under unrestricted partial matchings, with complete preferences, sharpens the currently exhibited logarithmic construction and is not inherited from a maximum-cardinality-only lower bound. The explicit n=5 first obstruction identifies the first nontrivial concentrated instability. The exact construction establishes Θ(n) worst-case growth without relying on heuristic numerics.
